Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. Team Rigi or Team Pilatus? 🇨🇭 🤑 Cost: If you're paying full price, they're quite similar. But if you have a Swiss Travel Pass or Saver Day Pass, @rigi.ch is completely FREE. And kids under 16? Always free. Rigi wins for value. 👀 Views: Both viewpoints are absolutely stunning, but quite different. Rigi has that wide-open Alpine meadow feel. While Pilatus is a tall rocky peak with lots of drama. So slight edge to @pilatus for the wow factor. 🥾 Hiking: No contest — Rigi wins. It has tons of trails for all levels — easy strolls to serious hikes. Pilatus does have three very short walks at the top to higher viewpoints, but all the longer hikes are steep, somewhat dangerous, and not beginner-friendly. 🎢 Amusements: Pilatus definitely takes this one. It’s got Switzerland’s longest summer toboggan 1.2 km, a treetop path, ropes climbing park with zip lines and free fall, and a big playground. Rigi? Just a couple of playgrounds. So if you're with kids and teens — Pilatus is a no-brainer. 👥 Crowds: Well, both are really popular, especially with international tourists,  but Rigi feels less crowded because you have More space to spread out. Just a couple minutes on a trail and escape the crowds so easily. Pilatus? Most people stay packed on the main viewing deck. It can feel a bit oppressive. 🚆 Ease of Travel: Rigi wins again. You take one boat, one mountain train — easy and timetables well coordinated. Pilatus has more transportation variety — boat, train, cable car, bus — But the bus part is confusing and not tourist-friendly. I’d suggest a taxi for that bit if it wasn’t so expensive. So, which mountain should you choose? ✅ Rigi: for value, hikes, and chill travel ✅ Pilatus: for thrills, views, and family fun Let me know in the comments — are you Team Rigi or Team Pilatus? #rigi #visitswitzerland #pilatus #ilovelucerne

Ragi bikin Ragu?? baca ini dulu👇 Buibuk, kalau roti atau donat kamu gak ngembang, bisa jadi ragi kamu lagi mogok kerja nih! Jangan sampai salah perlakuan sama ragi, ya! Yuk, simak biar raginya hidup sehat dan semangat bikin adonan! 1. Simpan Ragi di Tempat yang Kena Sinar Matahari    Ragi itu gak suka panas-panas, apalagi sinar matahari langsung! Simpan ragi di tempat sejuk dan gelap biar dia tetap fresh dan siap kerja maksimal. Jangan ditaruh di dekat jendela, ya! 2. Simpan Ragi dalam Jumlah Besar    Meskipun beli ragi jumlah besar,misal 500gram, jangan disimpan sekaligus, buibuk. Sebaiknya di-repack kecil-kecil dulu, biar lebih awet.  Baru deh simpan di kulkas, chiller, atau freezer biar tahan lama! Saat repack jangan kena tangan dan pastikan wadah repack vacuum dan kering ya buk.  Jika masi usaha skala kecil,sebaiknya beli kemasan sachet ya, agar tidak mubadzir. 3. Pakai Cairan yang Hangat Saat Ngadon    Ragi gak suka yang kepanasan. Kalau buibuk pakai air yang hangat, ragi malah bisa mati!  Pastikan airnya suhu ruang, bahkan air es atau es batu lebih baik. 4. Simpan di Plastik yang Gak Vacuum    Udara itu musuhnya ragi! Kalau simpan ragi di plastik yang gak vacuum, bisa-bisa ragi jadi lembap dan cepat rusak. Pastikan kedap udara, biar ragi tetap fresh. 5. Lupa Cek Tanggal Expired Ragi    Ini nih yang sering kelupaan. Ragi punya batas usia, buibuk. Ragi yang udah deket tanggal expired biasanya kerja gak maksimal. Jadi, rajin-rajin cek tanggalnya biar gak zonk pas bikin roti! 6. Cek keaktifan Ragi dengan air hangat  Cara ini bikin adonan cepat asam ya bu,  karena raginya aktif duluan, jadi mending lamain waktu proofing yaa bu, jauuuh lebih aman😍 Selamat bereksperimen, buibuk! Kalau raginya hidup, adonan insyaAllah melambung tinggi! Setinggi harapan mertua 😁😁semangaat🎉🎉 Semoga membantu yaa Buk♡♡ Follow buat tips lainnya seputar roti dan donat. #creatorsearchinsights #fypシ゚viral__  Sejarah Ragi  Simak penjelasan lengkap nya dibawah: Sejarah Ragi: Dari Kuno ke Modern 1. Zaman Kuno – Dipake tanpa tau namanya   - 7000–6000 SM: Mesopotamia & Mesir Kuno bikin bir & roti pake ragi liar dari udara. - 2000 SM: Cina udah fermentasi arak beras & kecap pake ragi herbal. - Nusantara: Tape & brem muncul dari teknik fermentasi Cina-India. Ragi dibikin dari beras + rempah. 2.  Tokoh Penemu/Perintis Ragi 1. Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (1680): Pertama liat sel ragi pake mikroskop. Dia nyebut "animalcules" tapi belum tau fungsinya.   2. Louis Pasteur (1857): Buktiin fermentasi itu kerja mikroorganisme hidup. Dia jelasin peran Saccharomyces cerevisiae → bapak mikrobiologi.   3. Theodor Schwann (1837): Ahli fisiologi Jerman yang nyebut ragi sebagai tumbuhan hidup & penyebab fermentasi alkohol. Dia salah satu pencetus "teori sel". Sebelum Pasteur, Schwann udah bilang fermentasi = proses biologis, bukan kimia biasa. 3.
